Hoang Mai, Hanoi

Objective

With over 4 years of experience in the E-commerce industry, I specialize in operational management and optimizing sales processes on major marketplaces. In my most recent role, I successfully maintained an operational score of 4.8/5.0 and contributed to a 10% increase in conversion rate within just 6 months. My goal over the next 2 years is to grow into a managerial position where I can lead a team to enhance the company’s online business performance.
